update retailer contracts, cart/payment/tracking flows, and customer-support language

update warehouse contracts, dispatch/support docs, and node-scoped visibility expectations
update manifest contracts, transfer SOPs, and exception handling expectations
update manifest event contracts, exception vocabulary, and source-target cache invalidation rules
preserve additive order states, routing/serviceability authority, and duplicate-request safety

routeAuthorityFreeze.changeRule: preserve idempotency, policy errors, and replay-safe provider handling
keep signature-first verification and transaction-id idempotency intact

routeAuthorityFreeze.owner: live location and execution signal authority
routeAuthorityFreeze.changeRule: keep authenticated identity enforcement and reconnect-safe fanout semantics intact

eventCatalogFreeze.changeRule: no event is added, renamed, or repurposed unless all source-of-truth locations are updated in the same batch

reliabilityAcceptance.draftAcceptanceTarget: core order and payment write paths complete without duplicate business outcomes under retry and replay
duplicate checkout taps and replayed webhooks collapse to one durable state transition
state-change event publish lag remains visible and recoverable without silent drop
stale reads and duplicate self-echo fanout remain detectable and bounded
out-of-zone orders are blocked deterministically and in-zone orders stay stable under duplicate attempts
live tracking recovers after reconnect without corrupting driver identity or route state
no infra-sensitive batch is treated as ready without isolated smoke evidence
rolling restart or pod loss does not orphan state-change delivery or force operator re-entry

backend.traceMiddleware: bootstrap.TraceMiddleware (X-Trace-Id normalization + outbox context propagation with trace_id injection for object payloads)
backend.sandboxBootstrapCommand: apps/backend-go/cmd/setup creates isolated Spanner instance/database, applies schema/spanner.ddl, and seeds the single supplier row for SSMR sandbox bring-up
backend.smokecheckCommand: apps/backend-go/cmd/ssmr-smokecheck asserts seeded supplier + Retailers schema state against isolated Spanner, validates Redis-backed perimeter readiness/membership in spatial mode, and validates Kafka topic isolation + round-trip flow
backend.smokeHarness: scripts/smoke_ssmr.sh (also exposed as make test-ssmr-infra and npm run infra:ssmr:test) orchestrates isolated compose bring-up, Kafka topic bootstrap, idempotent backend setup, Redis ping, backend health, and direct Spanner/spatial/Kafka proof; docker-compose.ssmr.yml invokes /usr/local/go/bin/go explicitly inside Go containers
backend.persistentGoCaches: docker-compose.ssmr.yml shares named pegasusx-ssmr-go-mod and pegasusx-ssmr-go-build volumes across Go containers; smoke_ssmr.sh preserves them by using docker compose down --remove-orphans
backend.ciStageGate: repo-root .github/workflows/ssmr-infra.yml runs make test-ssmr-infra for pegasusX/** changes and manual dispatches
backend.scaffoldOutboxRuntime: relay store selected at runtime: Spanner OutboxEvents authority when reachable, otherwise in-memory fallback; relay started from main
backend.orderDurabilitySeam: order/repository_spanner.go persists Orders rows and emitted outbox events atomically in one Spanner ReadWriteTransaction; bootstrap prefers Spanner repository when runtime wiring is available with in-memory fallback
backend.paymentDurabilitySeam: payment/repository_spanner.go persists PaymentSessions/PaymentAttempts/PaymentChargebacks/PaymentReversals/PaymentWebhooks rows and emitted outbox events atomically in one Spanner ReadWriteTransaction; bootstrap prefers Spanner payment repository when runtime wiring is available with in-memory fallback
backend.supplierDurabilitySeam: supplier/repository_spanner.go persists seeded supplier identity in Suppliers and rich onboarding/billing fields in SupplierProfiles, with durable topology reads/writes through Warehouses and Factories plus transactional outbox buffering
backend.adapterBridge: bootstrap attempts Redis cache transport and Kafka outbox transport with in-memory/logging fallback
backend.strictReliabilityMode: REQUIRE_INFRA_ADAPTERS fail-fast bootstrap on Redis/Kafka adapter init failure
backend.requestReliabilityMiddleware: bootstrap/reliability_middleware.go mounted after TraceMiddleware in main (fixed-window rate limits, priority shedding, per-class circuit-open responses), toggled by RELIABILITY_MIDDLEWARE_ENABLED
backend.paymentExecutionRouter: payment/execution.go routes checkout/chargeback/reversal actions with bounded retry/backoff+jitter and typed gateway policy errors before persistence/outbox emission
backend.paymentAttemptPersistence: payment/service.go persists checkout PaymentSessions + first PaymentAttemptRecord atomically via repository CreateSessionWithAttempt and surfaces additive attempt_id/execution_action/execution_mode/provider_reference metadata in checkout response and payment-required event payloads
backend.airwallexDirectExecutionFlag: AIRWALLEX_DIRECT_EXECUTION_ENABLED gates AIRWALLEX execution support in payment router
backend.strictModeStartupTests: bootstrap tests assert fail-fast on missing Redis/Kafka and success when both adapters are healthy
backend.spannerOutboxIntegrationCoverage: outbox/spanner_store_integration_test.go validates Append->Fetch->MarkPublished lifecycle against emulator-backed Spanner when available
backend.wsRelayTransport: ws:<hub>:fanout typed envelopes with source suppression; subscribers started from main
backend.orderSchema: schema/spanner.ddl includes Orders with JSON line-items bytes, total/currency, H3/lat/lng, version, timestamps, and supplier/retailer created-at indexes
backend.paymentSchema: schema/spanner.ddl includes PaymentSessions, PaymentAttempts, PaymentChargebacks, PaymentReversals, and PaymentWebhooks with supplier/retailer scoped payment-session indexes plus session/transaction lookup indexes
backend.supplierSchema: schema/spanner.ddl includes SupplierProfiles for onboarding and billing fields, while topology nodes persist in Warehouses and Factories
backend.spatialPerimeterBootstrap: bootstrap/data.go + bootstrap/bootstrap.go precompute supplier delivery coverage into Redis sets ssmr:delivery_perimeter and ssmr:delivery_perimeter:compacted (TTL=0) from supplier warehouse coordinates when available, with deterministic fallback center/radius
backend.topicIsolation: events.TopicMain resolves from KAFKA_TOPIC_MAIN at process start so isolated sandboxes can publish to tenant-specific Kafka topics without rewriting emit call sites
backend.supplierPortalApiProxy: apps/supplier-portal/app/api/[...path]/route.ts proxies same-origin /api/* requests to backend authority via SUPPLIER_BACKEND_BASE_URL/BACKEND_BASE_URL while preserving cookies and idempotency headers
backend.sharedSupplierContractBridge: packages/types/index.ts exports supplier register/login/configure/billing/profile/topology DTOs and packages/api-client/index.ts implements typed supplier methods with Idempotency-Key support and structured ApiError handling

infra: docker-compose.ssmr (isolated spanner/redis/kafka, topic bootstrap, backend-go + ai-worker, cmd/setup bootstrap, explicit /usr/local/go/bin/go for Go containers, named Go module/build cache volumes)
scripts/smoke_ssmr.sh (make test-ssmr-infra / npm run infra:ssmr:test proof of isolated Spanner/Redis/Kafka/bootstrap wiring, backend health, and Kafka round-trip delivery)
repo-root .github/workflows/ssmr-infra.yml (permanent CI gate running make test-ssmr-infra for pegasusX/** changes and manual dispatches)
terraform (vpc, spanner, redis, tenant-scoped secret-manager wiring for orders/spatial/realtime/webhook topics)
